name: Disposable development browser QA — backend suite recorded separately

steps.name: Materialize and verify exact candidate source
Build APIs, typecheck workspaces, and prove browser isolation
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; artifact_root="$PWD/.release/internal-ci/$CI_COMMIT_SHA"; build_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/lunchlineup-source-$CI_RUN_ID/build"; cd "$build_root"; npm run build --workspace @lunchlineup/api-contract; npm run build --workspace @lunchlineup/config; npm run build --workspace @lunchlineup/rbac; npm run test --workspace @lunchlineup/api-contract; npx turbo run build --env-mode=loose --filter=@lunchlineup/api-v2; npm run typecheck; npm run test --workspace @lunchlineup/api-v2; (cd apps/web && npx vitest run --project=unit tests/unit/qa-isolation-policy.test.ts tests/unit/settings-request.test.ts tests/unit/settings-save-state.test.ts tests/unit/invitation-recovery.test.ts tests/unit/profile-save-state.test.ts tests/unit/staff-action-confirmation.test.ts tests/unit/time-card-mutation-result.test.ts); npx playwright install chromium; npx tsx scripts/check-development-browser-isolation.ts "$artifact_root/development-browser-isolation.json"
